summary: Piscataquis County, Maine: state lookout on Soper Mountain from 1909, rebuilt of logs in 1916, steel tower from 1924; listed as gone.

facts.design: Log station in 1909, rebuilt of logs in 1916 with a cab on top; steel tower from 1924
facts.status_note: Listed as 'Tower Gone' by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date in sources read

corrections.why: 6.1 m is 20 feet, the 1920 inventory figure for the earlier wood tower. The 1924 steel tower that replaced the wood structure is 24 feet (7.3 m) per Maine Memory.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Maine Memory gives the 1924 steel tower as 24 feet; a 1924 newspaper item had planned 27 feet; the 1920 inventory lists a 20-foot wood tower. The story reports all three. The 24-foot figure is used in facts because it is the only source that describes the tower actually built.

sources.title: Forest Service lookout, Soper Mountain, ca. 1920

notes_for_editor: Brief height 6.1 m matches the 1920 wood tower, not the 1924 steel tower; correction proposed to 7.3 m, editor may want both. No source read gives a removal date or the circumstances of removal; the status 'gone' rests on the FFLA list only. Brief agency 'Maine Forestry District' is the header on the easternuslookouts page; the story uses Maine Forest Service from the Maine Memory caption. A 1935 photo caption on an FFLA Maine chapter Facebook post (search snippet only, page not readable) says the 1924 tower replaced two earlier wooden towers; not cited. No access or visit information found.
